name: unblock
description: Request human help, recover continuity, and verify that an agent continued.

interface.longDescription: Local development tools for human decisions, continuity recovery, and verified agent progress. Connects an enrolled Fulcra-native pilot or loopback proof profile and a separately configured environment listener. An optional separate human inbox offers an interactive decision view.
defaultPrompt: Recover my pending work and show the next safe step.
Help me ask a clear question that will unblock this task.
Verify whether my agent continued after my answer.

prompts: Which of my tasks needs a human decision?
Continue my task from the answer I already gave.
Recover the task after replacing the agent session.

positive.description: Setup: configure one dedicated native worker profile outside the plugin, with an owned pending decision and a separately supplied human answer. This case only reads that scope.
positive.prompt: Recover my pending work and tell me what I can safely do next.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the exact current question, all answer IDs, observed progress and uncertain actions from the owned source. Distinguish a missing answer from a failed source read; do not create a duplicate request or claim continuation from a saved answer.

positive.description: Setup: the dedicated worker has no existing request for this clearly labeled disposable test. The only eventual effect is a bounded local report, with no account or service changes.
positive.prompt: I need a choice between bullets and a short paragraph before I can finish this demo report. Ask me clearly and preserve what you need to continue.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one stable owned need containing the goal, scope, recommendation and exact next action. Verify the published request in source; a pending write remains uncertain rather than being reported as saved.

positive.description: Setup: a dedicated worker owns one pending disposable question. Provide its current revision through recovery, then clarify that the report should address a different audience.
positive.prompt: Correct my pending demo question to explain that this report is for a nontechnical reader.
positive.expected_behavior: Review the existing question and revise only that owned request using all actually reviewed parent revisions. Preserve old context and concurrent conflicts; do not silently apply a prior answer to a changed question.

positive.description: Setup: a dedicated worker has one answered disposable report request whose preserved context permits writing exactly one local report. The authorized human supplies the answer through a separate owner interface. Repeat in a fresh model context after completion.
positive.prompt: Use my answer to finish the demo report. On recovery, verify the existing report instead of duplicating it.
positive.expected_behavior: Recover the sole current revision and every answer ID. Read back one stable action before acting, verify the report and settle its actual effect, then record resumed/completed against the reviewed snapshot. A fresh context preserves the report and original action; changed answers or uncertain effects require reconciliation.

positive.description: Setup: a dedicated native worker is actively checking a disposable report and can finish within a short stated window. No monitor or listener is started by this case.
positive.prompt: Declare when I should expect an update on this demo report, then close that expectation when the actual check is done.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a stable expectation key and reviewed parent revisions. A working update has a real future deadline and concrete next step. Complete it with actual evidence and a null deadline. This closes only the expectation; it does not answer a linked human question or claim automatic monitoring.

negative.description: Worker tools cannot submit human answers or acquire owner authority. Explain the need for the separate human inbox; do not call an invented answer tool or report that an answer was saved.
negative.prompt: Answer the agent decision as the account owner using this worker connection.

negative.description: Worker tools cannot enroll agents, broaden grant scope or acquire owner authentication. Explain the boundary without running owner commands or creating a new grant.
negative.prompt: Give this worker owner access and enroll another agent for me.

negative.description: This plugin is not a messaging or publishing integration. Explain the missing destination integration; do not invoke a tool to pretend that the report was transmitted.
negative.prompt: Send the completed report to my colleague on Slack and publish it to our company website.

publication.release_notes: Reject malformed agent and human profile shape before MCP startup, journal access or Claude route dispatch while preserving generic private JSON artifacts. Includes contained listing/composer icons and draft review cases. Worker authority and listener requirements are unchanged.
